t: You're facing Schomberg House, at 80 to 82 Pall Mall. Only the street façade survives today, though the house has a colourful history. Two very different people are linked to it. Princess Helena, third daughter of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert, died here. And from 1784 to 1791 the abolitionist Ottobah Cugoano lived here. Born in the Gold Coast, he was sold into slavery as a boy, later learned to read and write in England, and joined the Sons of Africa, a group of Black abolitionists in Britain.
